Marissa / Marcus —

Finance can process the deposit but please note the following requirements before we issue the PO/payment:

1) Use cost center 6011-FieldMkt-Activation for vendor invoices tied to external demo activations.
2) We will issue a PO that caps authorized spend to $10,000 for the venue line (this keeps the request within monthly activation thresholds). If your total event budget remains $12,000, please confirm where food/AV will be charged (we can split across two cost centers if needed).
3) We need vendor W9 and certificate of insurance (COI) on file. If not in Coupa, please attach to the PO request.
4) Attached is the Draft_PO_template.xlsx — please fill vendor legal name, remit address and tax ID; I’ll convert to a formal PO and route for approvals.

If the vendor insists on deposit today and we don't have W9/COI, Finance can process a one-time prepay under a temporary hold but we will require follow-up documentation within 10 business days.
